caption: The drawing consists of a long, horizontal rectangular band centered on a larger, light beige background. The band has a brown border, and inside, it features a tan-colored interior. At the center of the band is an oval-shaped cartouche bordered by a blue dotted line. Inside the cartouche, there is cursive writing in black ink. Flanking the cartouche on both sides are floral arrangements with stems, green leaves, pinkish-red flower blossoms with yellow centers, white flowers with yellow centers, and red flower buds. The floral designs are symmetrical, spreading outward from the central cartouche, with leaves and flowers occupying the majority of the space within the band. The entire arrangement is simple and decorative, with no objects outside the central rectangular band.
title: Piano Decoration
